prompt: Create an original 60 second melodic breakbeat electronica instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: breakbeat drums, rounded bass, shimmering synth. Style: syncopated chopped drum rhythm under an evolving melody. Tempo approximately 144 BPM; C major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An energetic and uplifting electronic track featuring driving synth melodies, a pulsating bassline, and dynamic electronic drums. It has a modern, dance-oriented feel.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和振奋人心的电子音乐，具有驱动性的合成器旋律、脉动的低音线和动感的电子鼓。它带有一种现代舞曲的氛围。
